issues.desc: background.md ## Conversational Texture uses the abbreviation "B-impl" ("drive the whole B-impl program") without an explicit expansion in the text; a new reader must infer it means the adversarial-review build-implementation program from surrounding context. Recommend expanding on first use: e.g., "B-impl (adversarial-review build program)"
